svg.title: The inner 45 rings · a sealed arena
svg.desc: Close-up of primary rings zero through forty-five. A bank sits at the origin. Six spires sit on ring thirty, each with six adjacent pre-explored hexes. A continuous three-hex-thick mountain barrier fills rings thirty-three through thirty-five. Realm settlement begins at Realm ring three, primary ring forty-five. Hyperstructure foundation discovery is zero throughout rings zero to thirty-five.
svg.text: The inner 45 rings · a sealed arena
Primary layer at individual-hex scale · bank at 0 · spires at 30 · mountains at 33–35 · first Realm sites at 45
Discovery chance is zero on rings 0–35
Other eligible structures can still be discovered
Every inner spire lands inside the mountains.
No primary-layer ground route crosses the barrier.
The bank, all spires and their six neighbors are pre-explored. Mountains are fully pre-explored, impassable and spawn-free.
Rings 33–35 form a three-hex-wide barrier. Ring 32 is ordinary terrain; inner-spire neighbors on ring 31 stay clear.
